rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dataset

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cycle

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trackStar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).
Describes the type of annotation.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasContactPoint
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact has each `to` Agent as a contact point. The use of the `hasContactPoint` type is constrained to `ContactPointRelationship` classed relationships. The type of contact (i.e. security) may be specified using a `ContactPointRelationship` element.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.
A evidenceUID is a unique identifier assigned to an entity, item, or requirement.
This is the state of an affected Element at a specific moment in time.
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.
Identifies who or what created the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when there is a security related identifier of unspecified type.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.
ManufactureAction represents the act of creating a product by a manufacturing process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.
ISO level of automation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other relevant type of proof or documentation not covered above.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).

givenRole is a property that specifies the role being assigned in a RoleRelationship. It links the relationship to an instance of the Role class, defining the function, responsibility, or position that the source element confers upon the target element.
Class that describes an InstantiateVirtualHardwareProcess that is used to define VirtualHardware and its source.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides a requirement needed as input for another Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kilowattHour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Kilowatt-hour.
A rationale is supporting information that provides the underlying justification or reasoning for an associated element, decision, or process.
Owner or Lead of the project.
Provides an IntegrityMethod with which the integrity of an Element can be asserted.
An actual change to a product.
Availability of dataset.
Uniquely identifies an external element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is of a type not included in this list.
Records the storage of a product.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: yes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates presence of the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: symlink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This file represents a symbolic link (soft link).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `/Security/VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Provides information about the completeness of relationships.
Identifies from where or whom the Element originally came.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.
Capture the scope of information about a specific relationship between elements.
A state is an instance that describes what a system, component, subsystem, process, or project has achieved at any given time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audio
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is audio based, such as a collection of music from the 80s.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsDilithium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Dilithium](https://pq-crystals.org/dilithium/)
Sponsor of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is documentation.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.
Conveys information about how VEX status was determined.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.
Information related to physical hardware.
A set of geographic point location coordinates.
An Organization representing the SPDX Project.
Identifies when the Element was originally created.
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer assumes any support obligations.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.
Use Process defines actions used by elements.
A transport route refers to the specific path or network used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.
A contact point from an Artifact to an Agent.
Evaluation is an outcome considering results of a verification.
Identifies the full text of a License, in SPDX templating format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.
A value used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.
Title of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: diskImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a disk image that can be written to a disk, booted in a VM, etc. A disk image typically contains most or all of the components necessary to boot, such as bootloaders, kernels, firmware, userspace, etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.
An entity providing an assessment.
Provides information about the type of an SBOM.
A specification is a detailed description of the design, requirements, or features of a product, process, or system.
Indicates the specific RequirementVerification instance on which the EvaluationResult is based.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/IntegrityMethod is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timeseries
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded in an ordered sequence of timestamped entries, such as the price of a stock over the course of a day.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Not yet finalized; under development or review.
Type of data in a dataset.
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gln
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Location Number (GLN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gln) is a 13-digit number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a legal entity (e.g., a company or customer), a function within a legal entity, a physical location (e.g., a warehouse or a specific shelf in a store), or a digital location (e.g., an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) gateway).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeclaredLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact was discovered to actually contain each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo (for example, as detected by automated tooling).
Links a vulnerability and one or more elements designating the latter as products not affected by the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from leveraging the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: republishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability's details were tracked, aggregated, and/or enriched to improve context (i.e. NVD) by each `to` Agent.
Information about the type of contact point for `ContactPointRelationship`s.
A license or addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a /Build/Build element that describes a build step).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC 9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements with cardinality (number/count) of zero.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tls
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Transport Layer Security, or TLS, is a widely adopted security protocol designed to facilitate privacy and data security for communications over the Internet.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasSpecification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a specification for the `from` Element (`from` hasSpecification `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evaluatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been evaluated on the `to` Element(s).
An element of hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.
Provides a NamespaceMap of prefixes and associated namespace partial URIs applicable to an SpdxDocument and independent of any specific serialization format or instance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 7.0 - 8.9.
Products out of specification require a resolution action. This is the action of resolution.
Records the time when a recommended action was communicated in a VEX statement to mitigate a vulnerability.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.
Provides the license under which the SPDX documentation of the Element can be used.
Specifies whether the License is listed as free by the Free Software Foundation (FSF).
Location of a specific action.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deviceDriver
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents software that controls hardware devices.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: adler32
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Adler-32 checksum is part of the widely used zlib compression library as defined in [RFC 1950](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1950/) Section 2.3.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: install
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is used to install software on disk.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: model
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a machine learning or artificial intelligence model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's build phase, during development.
Designates elements as products where the impact of a vulnerability is being investigated.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: recording
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Captured datastream like audio, video, or any other kind of continuous electronic capture of events, behavior or conditions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/ExpandedLicensing/License is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Provides advise on how to mitigate or remediate a vulnerability when a VEX product is affected by it.
Country for which export controls must be taken into account.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability is not present in the product.
Specifies the VEX justification type.

The intended use of a given dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset may be distributed freely, without restriction.
References an Element on the right-hand side of a relationship.
Provides a CVSS version 2.0 assessment for a vulnerability.
Weight to express relevance in de minimis consideration.
How the dataset was collected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
A planned location where a good, product, or material is stored.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements of unknown identity or cardinality (number).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.
A QUDT unit applied to measurement criteria based on product type, region, and use.
Provides a detailed description of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar, .zip, etc.).
responsibilityCategory classifies the nature or domain of a responsibility transfer.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record the Package-URL for a software Package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal standard is a standard ratified by a recognized standards-development organization and published as a normative reference.
Provides a map of a property name to a value.
Link to the project contract.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.
A container for a grouping of SPDX 3 content characterizing details (provenance, composition, licensing, etc.) about a product.
Enumeration of the different kinds of SPDX file.
Expression for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md6
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [MD6 hash function](https://people.csail.mit.edu/rivest/pubs/RABCx08.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has other specific context information necessary to capture that the above set of enumerations does not handle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The affected code is not reachable through the execution of the code, including non-anticipated states of the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: report
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured documentation of test results, inspections, or analyses.
Provide an enumerated set of lifecycle phases that can provide context to relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when someone reviews the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: complete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).
Commentary on an assertion that an annotator has made.
Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: observation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation of direct monitoring or witnessing of the demonstration of processes, tests, or any kind of system responses during a specified timeframe under specified environmental conditions.
Specifies the CVSS qualitative severity rating of a vulnerability in relation to a piece of software.
Agent represents anything with the potential to act on a system.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.
Specifies the type of simulation model used to represent virtual hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assistiveAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 1 - Assistive automation. The system assists an operator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.
Energy consumed when finetuning the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a bill of materials related to a package.

Text specifying a province or state.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: performedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `from` Action is performedBy `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's testing phase, during development.
Defines the beginning of a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: email
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3696/) Section 3.
Specifies the type of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notAutomated
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 0 - Not automated. No automation. The operator fully controls the system.
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: megajoule
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Megajoule.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDistributionArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is distributed as an artifact in each `to` Element (e.g. an RPM or archive file).
A license that is not listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: decommission
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product's retirement and/or decommissioning.

Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.
Connects a vulnerability and an element designating the element as a product affected by the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset can be shared within a community of peers and partners.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

referenceSpecification provides a reference to a DefinedType that defines the specific meaning, structure, and semantics of a Role. It connects the role to its authoritative source definition, ensuring consistent interpretation across different contexts.
Describes the specific responsibility of a Role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and an email registration is required before accessing the dataset, although without an affirmative acceptance of terms.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.
Categories of presence or absence.
Limitation of the AI software.
Energy consumed during inference time by an AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: log
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Time-stamped records capturing system or operational data recorded as usually as a response to specific triggers in a specified environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: testedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been tested on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: firmware
